name: before-after-pairs
title: Before and after pairs
description: Before and after photo pairs side by side with text labels, a timeframe and what was done: no slider, so it is instant and survives print.
docs: Pass title, an optional description and pairs ({ id, before: { src, alt }, after: { src, alt }, caption, timeframe?, details? }). Alt text is required for both images of a pair. The two images share one aspect ratio (4:3, or set ratio to 3/4 for portrait work) so the pair lines up, each carries a Before or After label in its corner as text on a solid chip, never colour alone, and on a phone the pair stacks with the labels intact. There is no slider and no animation, so the comparison is immediate; the chips keep their fill when printed without background graphics. details is the list of what was done; timeframe is read as 'Time it took: 6 weeks'. labels carries the fixed words.
